                if (x+1 < 64 and grid[y][x+1] == grid[y][x] and
                    y+1 < 64 and grid[y+1][x] == grid[y][x] and
                    grid[y+1][x+1] == grid[y][x]):
                    has_blocks = True
                    break
        if has_blocks:
            active.append(y)
    return active

def get_block_colors(grid, y):
    """Extract the colors of the 2x2 blocks in row y."""
    colors = []
    # Blocks are at x=17, 20, 23, 26, 29, 32, 35, 38, 41, 44
    xs = [17, 20, 23, 26, 29, 32, 35, 38, 41, 44]
    for x in xs:
        if x+1 < 64 and y+1 < 64:
            c = grid[y][x]
            if c != 4 and c != 3 and c != -1:
                colors.append(c)
    return tuple(colors)
